title: 100% cotton sheets.
text: 100% cotton sheets.. These are decent thickness for the price and are listed as 100% cotton.  The are pretty wrinkly out of the dryer, but honestly, that's kind of the nature of 100% cotton.  So if wrinkled sheets are problem for you - unless you press your linens you probably won't like them.  I can feel that they will become softer with each wash as they are cotton.  I purchased both the ivory and the white. I like the "striping" as it helps me get the fitted bottom sheet on the "right" way the first time. Ha. They arrived quickly (I have prime) and in great shape with other items I ordered.  Having said all this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
